title: About
headline: I'm a Python developer who builds tested Django and Flask applications, APIs and automation.
paragraphs: I'm a **Python developer** with a **B.Tech in Computer Science** and **1.9 years** of experience building tested **Django and Flask** applications, **REST APIs** and automation.

At **Cognizant** I build web features and REST APIs (models, views, serializers, authentication) on **SQL Server and MySQL**, and write Python scripts that replace manual tasks with documented solutions.

I work directly with **clients and stakeholders** to gather requirements, demo progress and turn feedback into working features, in **Agile** teams that use **Git**, code reviews, **unit tests** and acceptance criteria.
Outside work I build **AI/ML projects** in Python: a **TensorFlow CNN** that detects facial emotion in real time, and a **PyTorch NLP chatbot** that recommends music through the **Spotify REST API**.
I use **AI-assisted tools** to speed up coding and debugging, reviewing and testing all generated code, and I've completed **Generative AI** and **SQL Server Administration** training.
